summary: Replaced the global settings with an immutable Settings value and make(), threaded a `conf` parameter through all code that needs settings, removed import-time and stale caches (fx factors, zone table, fuel factor, units, dim divisor, tax default), keyed the quote cache by Settings, and updated/added tests (all 66 pass). I had no pre-refactor copy to diff CLI output against, so behavior equality rests on preserving evaluation order and logic.
